weights.description: tensor names of the weights manifest, by the half of the layer they feed (a graph input with such a name is bound to that tensor of the layer)

chain.description: HEAD = attention half of layer 0; BLOCK i (i = 0 .. N-2) = feed-forward half of layer i + attention half of layer i+1; TAIL = feed-forward half of layer N-1 + final norm; lm_head. Per layer the runtime binds the weights of the 'attention_weights' layer and the 'ffn_weights' layer from the weights manifest.

per_layer_type_inputs.description: rope_cos / rope_sin / attention_mask of an attention half are bound with the tables of the layer type of ITS layer (see model.json: layer_types, rope, sliding_window)

kv.prefill: chunks of the chunk size, the last chunk is left-padded; one-hot row selectors write the real rows
kv.decode: the new row goes into a staging buffer; attention reads concat(main cache, staging); flush graph moves the staging rows into the main cache every staging_rows steps

logits.note: argmax / sampling over the first `vocab` entries only
